self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1. Scope of Work: The successful bidder shall provide all event-related services, including stage arrange ments, sound systems, lighting, LED walls, seating arrangements, decoration, photography, videography a nd other items as specified in the Scope of Work (SOW). 2. Site Inspection: Bidders are advised to inspect the event venue before submitting their quotations to assess the actual requirements, site conditions, electrical arrangements and installation feasibility. Site ins pection shall not be mandatory unless specifically justified. 3. Experience: The bidder should have relevant experience in organizing school Annual Day celebrations, cultural programmes or similar institutional events. Experience requirements, if prescribed, shall be propor tionate to the value and nature of the contract and subject to applicable GeM provisions. 4. Quality of Materials: All materials, equipment, furniture and decorative items supplied shall be of goo d quality, clean, presentable, safe and suitable for a school function. 5. Installation and Completion: All stage arrangements, seating, lighting, sound systems and other inst allations shall be completed at least one day before the scheduled programme, or within the timeline specified by the Vidyalaya. 6. Technical Rehearsal: The successful bidder shall ensure the availability of technical personnel during r ehearsals and the main event. Sound systems, microphones, lighting and LED displays shall be tested befo re commencement of the programme. 7. Standby Arrangements: Adequate backup arrangements shall be provided for essential equipment, i ncluding microphones, sound systems, lighting and LED display components, to avoid interruption during t he programme. 8. Electrical Safety: All electrical installations, cables, connections and equipment shall comply with appl icable electrical safety standards. Proper insulation, earthing and cable management shall be ensured. 9. Safety of Students and Staff: The bidder shall ensure that all temporary structures, stage installatio ns, seating and electrical arrangements are safe for students, staff, parents and invited guests. 10. Qualified Technical Personnel: The bidder shall deploy sufficient trained and experienced personnel for installation, operation, supervision and dismantling of the event arrangements. 11. Coordination with Vidyalaya: The successful bidder shall coordinate with the Annual Day Organizin g Committee and make necessary adjustments within the approved scope as instructed by the authorized Vidyalaya representative. 12. No Substandard Substitution: The bidder shall not replace approved equipment or materials with i nferior-quality items. Any equivalent substitution shall require prior approval from the Vidyalaya. 13. Transportation and Labour Charges: The quoted rates shall include transportation, loading, unload ing, installation, labour, dismantling and all other incidental expenses required for successful execution of the work. 14. Cleaning and Restoration: The bidder shall remove all temporary installations, equipment and wast e materials after completion of the programme and restore the venue to its original condition. 15. Damage to Property: Any damage caused to Vidyalaya property due to negligence of the bidder or it s personnel shall be rectified by the bidder at its own cost. 16. Payment Conditions: Payment shall be released after satisfactory completion of the services, verific ation by the designated committee and submission of a proper invoice, subject to applicable GeM contract terms. 17. Non-performance: In the event of delay, deficiency in service or non-compliance with the approved s pecifications, appropriate action may be taken in accordance with the applicable GeM contract provisions.

18. Compliance with Laws: The bidder shall comply with applicable statutory requirements, labour laws, safety regulations and tax provisions. 2. Special Conditions Recommended for School Annual Day VIP Seating: Clean, presentable and comfortable seating arrangements shall be provided for chief guests, dignitaries and other invitees as per the approved specifications. Stage Safety: The stage and temporary structures shall be stable, properly secured and suitable f or cultural performances by students. Sound Quality: Sound systems shall provide clear audio without excessive distortion, and volume shall remain within applicable permissible limits. LED Wall: LED screens shall provide adequate visibility, brightness and resolution suitable for the v enue. Fire Safety: Decorative materials and electrical installations shall not obstruct emergency exits, an d applicable fire safety requirements shall be followed. Event Support: A responsible coordinator from the bidder's side shall remain available throughout the event for immediate resolution of technical or logistical issues.
